projections.source: W3C PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
projections.projection: Provenance uses typed entity/activity derivation relations and separately represents alternate and specialization relations between entities referring to the same underlying thing.
projections.rakl_effect: Use typed ancestry plus alternate/specialization semantics; do not collapse provenance identity into one flat lineage label.

projections.source: New world of big data-new challenges for evidence synthesis: impact of data duplication on estimates generated by meta-analyses and the development of a framework for its identification and management
projections.projection: Overlapping data from common registries can bias meta-analytic estimates; the authors use data source, sampling timeframe and inclusion characteristics to detect potential duplication.
projections.rakl_effect: Source/publication count is not an independence proxy; shared-data ancestry must be explicitly represented and checked.

projections.source: Phylogenomic comparative methods: Accurate evolutionary inferences in the presence of gene tree discordance
projections.projection: Common ancestry can be mosaic: different loci may follow discordant histories, and a single species tree can mislead comparative inference. The paper develops multi-history methods and validates them in simulation and wild tomatoes.
projections.rakl_effect: Avoid a single flat evidence-lineage label as the complete dependence model; allow multi-parent ancestry graphs and preserve uncertainty about unobserved dependence.

projections.projection: A maintained Python implementation of W3C PROV supports in-memory PROV assertions, multiple serializations and graph conversion.
projections.rakl_effect: Confirms that generic provenance infrastructure already exists. RAKL keeps a minimal dependency-free scientific support contract rather than claiming provenance implementation as novel.

retained_new_rakl_semantic_objects: NO_KNOWN_SHARED_ANCESTRY is distinct from statistical/epistemic independence
generator corroboration can only be preserved or downgraded by lineage evidence
unknown ancestry fails closed rather than counting as independent support
provenance component count is structural and must not be relabeled statistical effective N
deduplicated_not_retained_as_new: generic warning that duplicated data can bias evidence synthesis
